summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric disclosed an October 12, 2026 Transaction Agreement to divest its robotics business to FFR, with subsidiary Smart Technology Holdings as Cayman Seller and FF Robotics merging into FFR Acquisition Sub LLC. Aggregate purchase price is $200 million, subject to a fully diluted option adjustment, with closing consideration of 1,317,949 FFR common shares plus 65,427 further shares, structured as a Section 368 reorganization. The deal follows a September 25, 2026 non-binding term sheet; closing depends on pre-closing internal restructuring and regulatory conditions. Watch regulatory clearance, option adjustment mechanics, stock consideration valuation, and residual FFAI overhang.
